verdict.rationale: ADK is a code-first framework from a public GitHub repo that runs on the user's own infrastructure. It runs locally with `adk run`, `adk web` and `adk api_server`, deploys to a local Docker container with `adk deploy docker`, and its docs describe container packaging for any environment and offline use with no Google Cloud connection, including locally running models. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted production deployment, and the docs note the ADK Web dev UI is not meant for production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This is a good option if you prefer to run offline or disconnected, or otherwise in a system that has no connection to Google Cloud.
You can manually package your Agent into a container image and then run it in any environment that supports container images.

Deploying the Agent Locally with Docker Container:

adk deploy docker --with_ui <agent-folder>
we provide adapters that let you connect with many other models and model providers, including locally running models.
